news.title: Vera Vita Living to invest ₹600 crore in  senior living project in Hyderabad
news.para: Vera Vita Living plans to invest about ₹600 crore over four-five years to develop Amaya, a senior living community in Hyderabad. The project is part of a 13-acre master plan, with phase-I comprising 256 units at an investment of about ₹250 crore.

news.title: China's property stocks fall as new rules upend presale funding playbook
news.para: The recent introduction of new regulations has resulted in a notable decline in the shares of Chinese property developers. These regulations are tailored to decrease reliance on pre-sale funds for construction, thus imposing additional funding challenges for developers. Consequently, state-owned enterprises have suffered notable losses during this transition, further exacerbating the ongoing difficulties within the property sector and its ramifications for the broader Chinese economy.

news.title: Andhra Pradesh government sanctions 17,912 houses under PMAY-Urban 2.0
news.para: Andhra Pradesh has approved the construction of nearly 18,000 new homes, totaling an expenditure of around Rs 448 crore. This project, under the Beneficiary-led Construction scheme, will support urban residents by enabling India to contribute sixty percent of the costs while the state takes on forty percent. Beneficiaries should anticipate covering any extra expenses beyond the approved unit cost. The initiative is designed to enhance housing availability in urban areas.

news.title: Property registrations in Mumbai rise 11% to 12,503 units in August 2026: Knight Frank
news.para: Mumbai is projected to record 12,503 property registrations in August 2026, the highest for the month in 14 years, according to Knight Frank India. Stamp duty collections are expected to rise 12% year-on-year to ₹1,123 crore.

news.title: Ekta World launches ₹1,200-crore premium commercial real estate in Bandra, Khar & Santacruz
news.para: Ekta World has unveiled The Business District Collection, a groundbreaking commercial real estate initiative worth ₹1,200 crore. Focusing on luxury office spaces in Bandra, Khar, and Santacruz West, this platform is designed to adapt to the changing demands of businesses prioritizing employee convenience and experience. It aims to attract various enterprises in these well-established locales, parallel to Mumbai's ongoing enhancements in transport infrastructure.

news.title: Jabalpur consumer forum orders builder to pay ₹1.5 lakh for incomplete house
news.para: The Jabalpur Consumer Forum has directed a builder to compensate for a house that was never completed, mandating a payment of Rs 1.50 lakh within 45 days. This figure includes Rs 5,000 allocated for legal expenses. The builder was deemed guilty of inadequate service, and failure to pay will incur a 7% annual interest penalty.

news.title: Repair, maintain all street lights in Patna civic body's area: Bihar CM
news.para: Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary ordered officials to ensure all street lights function. He directed immediate repairs and regular maintenance of existing lighting infrastructure. New street lights will be installed using integrated solar-based systems for easier operation. A study will assess potential electricity savings from converting all lights to solar power. Choudhary also emphasized improving Patna's urban appearance and cleanliness.

news.title: Bhopal civic body to launch shutdown drive against 130 commercial properties
news.para: The Bhopal Municipal Corporation is initiating a shutdown drive on Monday aimed at commercial properties. Approximately 130 properties, including hotels and restaurants in residential areas, have failed to adhere to final notices. A team of over 150 personnel will execute this operation across six assembly constituencies, with the support of local police to ensure enforcement.

news.title: India data centre footprint may reach 101 million sq ft by 2030: Report
news.para: India’s data centre footprint is projected to grow from nearly 27 million sq ft in H1 2026 to over 101 million sq ft by 2030, according to Anarock Capital. The sector has investment commitments of over $300 billion, supported by AI, cloud adoption, digital payments and rising data consumption.

news.title: EPC sector revenue grows 2% in Q1 FY27, recovery depends on H2 execution: Ind-Ra
news.para: India Ratings and Research expects EPC companies to record mid-to-high single-digit revenue growth in FY27, with largely stable margins. The sector reported 2% year-on-year revenue growth in Q1 FY27, while EBITDA margin fell to 9.5%, a multi-quarter low.

news.title: Mumbai, Delhi-NCR, Bengaluru among top APAC logistics markets for rental growth: Report
news.para: Mumbai, Delhi-NCR and Bengaluru ranked among the top 10 Asia-Pacific logistics markets for annual rental growth in H1 2026, according to report by Knight Frank. Mumbai recorded 5.3% year-on-year growth, followed by Delhi-NCR at 5.2% and Bengaluru at 4.4%.

news.title: BFSI accounts for 36% of GCC-led office transactions in H1 2026: Knight Frank
news.para: BFSI occupiers leased 7.32 million sq ft of office space for GCC-led transactions in H1 2026, up 70% year-on-year, according to Knight Frank India. The sector accounted for 36% of the overall 20.6 million sq ft of GCC-related office transaction volumes across the top eight cities.

news.title: Two Goa men booked for extorting ₹41 lakh from The House of Abhinandan Lodha
news.para: Mumbai police have launched an investigation into an extortion case involving two residents from Goa and their accomplices. Allegations state that they coerced a real estate firm into paying Rs 41 lakh and further demanded Rs 6 crore, threatening to disrupt ongoing construction activities in Goa. The incident came to light when the liaison officer reported persistent threats to the police, prompting action from NM Joshi Marg police.

news.title: Architects warn legal action if Lucknow development body doesn’t roll back empanelment decision
news.para: In Uttar Pradesh, architects are raising concerns over a newly introduced empanelling process by housing development authorities. They believe this initiative adds unnecessary complexities and creates arbitrary barriers to practice. The Council of Architecture, the top governing body for architects, has joined the dissent, warning that legal action may ensue if the Lucknow Development Authority does not retract its decision.

news.title: Plan to develop five cities in state on par with Bengaluru: Karnataka CM
news.para: The government has initiated plans to develop five cities, with Mysuru as one of the key centers, to alleviate traffic congestion in Bengaluru. To facilitate better traffic management, Outer Ring Roads will be established in these cities. This year’s Dasara celebration aims to reach international acclaim, with fresh ideas and increased participation from diverse groups ensuring a grand event.

news.title: Trichy civic body targets top 100 property tax defaulters in city who owe ₹9.4 crore
news.para: Trichy Corporation is targeting its top 100 property tax defaulters for significant revenue recovery. These defaulters collectively owe the local body Rs9.4 crore in outstanding property taxes. The corporation plans to take strict action against those who continue to delay payments. This includes potential suspension of essential services like water and drainage connections. The move aims to address the ongoing fund crunch affecting city maintenance and new proposals.

news.title: Bandlaguda residents urge Telangana government to lift 22-A curbs
news.para: In Bandalguda, the residents of Krishinagar and Ajay Nagar colonies are rallying for the removal of their properties from the 22-A prohibited list. Hundreds of homes, some standing for almost 40 years, were built with proper permits from the authorities. The abrupt classification of their land as government property has thrown their lives into chaos, urging them to seek urgent relief.

news.title: Aerial survey, 3D model to map Ahmedabad’s entire infrastructure
news.para: Ahmedabad is set to launch a comprehensive GIS initiative designed to produce an all-encompassing digital map of the city. This project will utilize geo-coding for properties and assign unique digital door IDs to facilitate tax verification. Using cutting-edge aerial surveys and mobile LiDAR technology, the city will create an accurate 3D model, enhancing planning and disaster management capabilities.

news.title: Goa: Canacona villagers protest against mega housing project
news.para: In Canacona, opposition is mounting against a sizable housing project that plans to build almost 200 flats. Residents have expressed their objections in writing last year, yet approvals were still given. They assert that the construction license was not thoroughly examined and highlight risks to local roads and utilities. Determined to push back, the community is ready to resort to legal measures to protect their interests.

news.title: RERA recovery gets digital push as Karnataka government targets ₹1,090 crore dues
news.para: Karnataka is preparing to unveil a digital system aimed at tracking revenue recovery certificates effectively. By integrating government databases for better asset tracing, this initiative seeks to align RERA orders with the actual collection of dues. The system is expected to be live by the middle of next month, bringing optimism to homebuyers for more rigorous action on builder defaults.
